preconditions: Authenticated human mailbox on an owned domain
incrementalProviderCost: USD_0_IF_EXISTING_MAILBOX_AND_PHONE; no purchase authorized by this mission.
stopRule: Stop at five qualified conversations; no paid pilot means kill/rethink.

sources.claim: Commercial email needs truthful headers/subject, ad identification, postal address, opt-out and timely honor of opt-out.
Manual B2B calls are not a license for deception; no robocall, prerecorded or autodial in this plan.
Gmail sender authentication and low complaint practice.
Use 0.3% complaint rate as a ceiling, not a target.
Do not use Resend for unsolicited cold outreach.
Do not use invitations to pitch unknown people.
